data.summary_en: UCoE (Unified Co-Evolution), training-free, co-evolving executable verifier programs and agent harness states with fixed parameters, selected by weakest contrast-family discriminative power (driving capacity) on response contrasts. Across six open-ended benchmarks, preference over matched direct generation averages 59.00% (Qwen3-8B) and 57.19% (Qwen3.8-27B), +9.00 and +7.19 points.
